CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

ITEMS:

[I36] 【古代的时候】   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]
  her past correction: [古代的时候→在古代]

[I37] 一个男孩子跟【他】的妈妈住在中国   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: the story starts with a pronoun: introduce the character first
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: 有一个孩子和他的妈妈[+住在一起]
  her past correction: 他跟他的妈妈住在一个小房子[+里] — her note: 在Place
  her past correction: [-他]跟他的妈妈住在一个小房子

[I38] 所以孟子老是祭拜【^】   correction: ∅ → 他们   strength: suggestion
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧一直祭拜 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: [-所以他们]祭拜 — her note: there is no cause-effect relationship
  her past correction: 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain

[I39] 但是城市【有才】两个学校   correction: 有才 → 才有   strength: error
  checker's note: 才 should come before 有 here
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [去→去了]一个最好的学校 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 而是因为[学校→学业]很难
  her past correction: ⟦不是商店而是学校⟧ — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong, 商店is not conventionally related to对教育有好处

[I40] 但是城市有才两【个】学校   correction: 个 → 所   strength: error
  checker's note: 所 is the measure word for schools
  rule card (near_synonym_precision, Vocabulary): Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <correct> because it means <intended meaning/context>; <wrong> is used for <different meaning/context>.  Her terms: 了completed
  her past correction: 而是因为[学校→学业]很难
  her past correction: [去→去了]一个最好的学校 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: ⟦不是商店而是学校⟧ — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong, 商店is not conventionally related to对教育有好处

items.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。
This character appears for the first time, so please introduce his mother briefly with a noun phrase, such as 孟子的妈妈, instead of only using 他。
It would be clearer to add 他们, because both Mengzi and his mother live next to the cemetery and may worship there.
Put 才 before 有 here: 才有两个学校 means “there are only two schools.”
Use 所 for schools: 一所学校. 个 is a general measure word, but 所 is the usual measure word for a school.
